story: Stage 19 of La Vuelta 2026 featured a long battle for the breakaway with high average speeds early on. After 120 km, a decisive 16-man break formed. Despite chase efforts, the peloton gave them space. On the climb, Buitrago attacked twice, but Dunbar caught him in the final 700m and launched a solo attack to win the stage.
